messages:
kevin: Heads-up — we've got a cross-repo dependency loop blocking merges: SDK PR 412, API PR 805, Console PR 128, and Helm chart bump. Need to sequence these so we can cut a patch today. Who can take lead on ordering?

sarah: Looking. SDK change adds new client method `split_stream` that API PR depends on. SDK CI is green except a single review requested from @maria. @kevin which API changes reference the new method?

maria: Console PR uses the new client call via sdk v0.9.2 but API currently returns a slightly different JSON shape for stream items. I left comments on API #805 about the response shape mismatch. pinging @dave for release plan and risk.

dave: Proposal: merge API schema fix first, then SDK, then Console, then Helm chart. That keeps runtime compatibility and minimizes canary churn. Any objections?

jen: CI on API is failing integration on our side — flakey `kv_cache_test`. Snippet from CI log: ```ERROR: kv_cache_test.py::test_prefix_eviction — Timeout after 120s``` @sam-eng-sre can you take a look?

sam-eng-sre: On it, re-running the failing job now. Also a quick note — API Helm values are still using `runtime:latest` in the chart, we should pin image tag to avoid surprises. I'll open a tiny PR to pin to `runtime:2026-03-16-rc`.

ci-bot: Re-run started for API PR #805 — triggered by @sam-eng-sre.

ci-bot: Re-run complete: API #805 — all checks passed.

sarah: Great. SDK is ready to merge after API. @maria can you re-run console e2e after SDK is cut? We'll need to bump the SDK dependency in console `package.json` to `0.9.3`.

maria: Will run e2e now, ETA ~30m. FYI console had a flaky CSS build earlier unrelated to the SDK change; I fixed that in a separate commit. I'll push results here.

kevin: I'll sequence merges as: API -> SDK -> Console -> Helm. I'll also coordinate a staging canary after Helm is bumped. @dave do you want me to hold the Helm bump until canary looks good?

dave: Yes, hold helm merge until 2 hours of canary metrics look stable. Also add a short migration note in release notes about the response shape change so SDK users are aware.

kevin: Noted. Posting PR links here for visibility: https://git.redwood/api/pull/805 https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/412 https://git.redwood/console/pull/128 https://git.redwood/charts/pull/67

sarah: :thumbsup: I'll merge SDK as soon as API is merged. @kevin ping me after API merge so I can cut the SDK release and tag.

maria: Console e2e passed after bump to `0.9.3`. Updated `package.json` and pushed. PR comment: "bump sdk -> 0.9.3, e2e green".

kevin: API merged at 1740537800 — confirmed by Git hook.

sarah: SDK released 0.9.3 and merged. Tag `v0.9.3` created.

ci-bot: Charts PR #67 requires `Chart.yaml` version bump to `1.4.2` and runtime tag pin. Please update.

dave: Reviewing chart PR now. If green I'll merge and trigger the rollout after the canary window.

jen: Canary metrics at +45m: p95 latency +3ms, error rate 0.01%, CPU within expected range. Looks stable so far.

kevin: Thanks all — proceeding with helm merge after @dave gives the final thumbs. Will monitor canary and report back. :rocket:

ci-bot: Helm chart PR #67 merged by @dave at 1740537880 — release pipeline triggered.

kevin: Closing the coordination thread — everything merged and released to staging. If any post-deploy regressions appear, open a new thread and ping the release owner. Thanks everyone!
